scope: Archived CDN service status; no historical price or capacity claims retained without primary support.

supports: StackPath decided to cease CDN operations.
Akamai acquired approximately 100 enterprise customer contracts; technology and personnel were excluded.
The parties announced a 90-day transition services agreement.

limitations: The official notice does not establish an exact CDN shutdown date; no November 22 date is asserted.
Historical prices, capacity and feature claims were not verified and were removed from the website override.

supports: Acquisition completed for selected customer contracts and non-exclusive patent rights.
The transaction excluded Edgio personnel, technology and network assets.

sources.access: opened; article body available despite a generic authorization banner
supports: Microsoft's official service retirement FAQ lists January 15, 2025 as the Edgio platform shutdown date.
The FAQ says Microsoft was informed that the Edgio platform would end service on that date.
Akamai announced funding for transition and wind-down until the planned mid-January 2025 end of Edgio CDN operations.

limitations: https://devblogs.microsoft.com/azure-sdk/azd-cdn-changing-january-2025/ returned HTTP 403 on direct open; it is not used as the website evidence link.
The January 15 date is attributed to Microsoft's platform retirement notice; this is not a claim about dissolution of the legal entity.
Historical pricing, free-plan policy, capacity and video-plan claims were not verified and were removed from the website override.

supports: Lumen completed the sale of selected CDN customer contracts to Akamai.
Lumen announced a 90-day transition, followed by planned wind-down of its content delivery services.

limitations: The announcement describes a planned wind-down after the transition; no exact operational shutdown date is inferred.
The CDN wind-down does not imply closure of Lumen as a company.
Historical prices, capacity and feature claims were not verified and were removed from the website override.
